profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer | FinOps & Cloud Cost Optimization | AWS | Machine Learning | Capital One
profile.summary:
As a Senior Software Engineer at Capital One, I operate at the intersection of advanced technology and financial strategy, specializing in Cloud Cost Optimization (FinOps) and enterprise-wide AWS efficiency.

My core mission is to drive sustainable cost savings and performance enhancements by developing and scaling the internal Cloud Cost Optimization Platform. I strategically leverage my expertise in Machine Learning (ML) and AI to design and implement predictive models that proactively detect, predict, and automate resource optimization opportunities.

With over 5 years of full-stack engineering experience (Python, Go, Java, React, Angular), I combine technical depth with strategic foresight:
- M.S. in Computer Science (Specialization in Machine Learning) from Georgia Tech.
-  MBA from the University of Maryland, applying business strategy daily to cloud economics.
-  FinOps Certified Practitioner, AWS Certified, and Technology management certification 

Key Contributions & Achievements:
- Leadership: Successfully led a team of 4 interns in the end-to-end delivery of a high-value budget optimization tool.
- Impact: Directly contribute to continuous, quantifiable monthly cost savings through participation in AWS right-sizing initiatives.
- Validated Expertise: Achieved a Top 5 finish (out of 400+ participants) in the AWS AI League event, validating deep expertise in LLM fine-tuning and prompting.

I am passionate about maximizing cloud value through intelligent automation and strategic governance, ensuring resources are efficient, governed, and optimized at scale.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Lead Software Engineer driving FinOps and AWS cloud efficiency across the Capital One enterprise. As a core developer for the internal Cloud Cost Optimization Platform, I ensure robust AWS governance and resource optimization at scale. In this role, I strategically implement Machine Learning and AI models to analyze utilization patterns, proactively predict spending, and automate optimization opportunities. Additionally, I help drive Tokenomics strategy to ensure scalable, cost-effective adoption of generative AI across the organization.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer focused on FinOps and AWS Cloud Efficiency across the Capital One enterprise.

Serve as a core developer and contributor to the internal Cloud Cost Optimization Platform, ensuring proper AWS governance and optimizing resource usage at scale.

Led a team of 4 interns in the successful delivery of a new budget optimization tool, enhancing organizational control over cloud spending.

Participated in continuous right-sizing initiatives that deliver substantial, quantifiable monthly cloud cost reductions.

Strategically implement Machine Learning and AI models to analyze AWS resource utilization, proactively detecting, predicting, and automating optimization opportunities.

Achieved a Top 5 finish in the AWS AI League event (out of 400+ participants) for expertise in fine-tuning and prompting Large Language Models (LLMs), demonstrating advanced AI skills.Currently working on the strategy side of cost optimization using machine learning and AI to detect predict, and optimize AWS resources to gain cost savings opportunities and performance enhancements.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer in Wireless Meraki Routers dashboard team leading projects to increase functionality and security. 

Designed and implemented a strategy to allow dashboard users to enroll in firewall and network traffic security management using Cisco Umbrella.

Lead a team to change how the Meraki dashboard handles end of life subscriptions and how users would navigate renewing their subscriptions
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Ruby on Rails · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Senior Software Engineer in Fraud. Helping lead projects in the fraud detection and mitigation platform. Working in ruby on rails to create a platform designed to help prevent, detect and manage fraud cases.
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby · Fraud Detection · Team Leadership · Ruby on Rails · Leadership · Fraud Prevention · Kafka Streams

positions.title: Software Engineer in Credit Card Fraud
positions.description:
Developing fraud features to detect transaction Fraud in real time using big data.
 
Created APIs and Kafka streams to prevent fraud in real time transaction
 
Full stack engineer using AWS, Java Docker APIs on ECS, Python Lambdas, EMR Clusters, PySpark, Hadoop and CICD pipelines.

positions.title: Software Engineer in Credit Card Fraud
positions.description:
Full Stack Engineer used machine learning and micro-services to detect First Party Fraud via Java Spring Boot APIs using AWS ECS and Jenkins 

Gained hands on experience creating parallel processing using Apache Camel to call internal and external data sources. 

Performed AWS disaster recovery, built performance testing suites, created acceptance tests and JUnit test for the teams API.

Mentored interns and new employees, helping them onboard to the company and get associated with our AWS stack and our Java code base.

positions.title: TDP Software Engineer in Cyber Security
positions.description:
AWS Cloud Security specializing in Identify and Access Management(IAM) security and risk analysis.	

Full stack Engineer working on IAM security, using Amazon’s Boto3 API for automated reasoning to assess the risk of a given IAM role 

Created APIs to collect IAM information from over 700 AWS accounts in order to assess the risk of the IAM roles. 

Developed a React website to help users detect and mitigate their IAM security flaws. 

Deployed Lambdas, EC2’s, RDS, SQS, and other AWS resources using Jenkins and Capital One’s internal pipeline

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description: Tutoring Penn State Students in Math and Computer Science

positions.title: Director Of Technology
positions.description: Lead UPUA on a transition of their communications platform to Microsoft Teams. Updated the UPUA website for increased user accessibility.

positions.title: Board Of Directors Student Representative
positions.description:
Elected to the board of directors of the non-profit Collegian Inc. who is the parent company of the student run newspaper The Daily Collegian. 
Oversaw the business by voting on budgets and other crucial matters to facilitate the growth of the business

positions.title: Technology Development Program Intern
positions.description:
Full stack development taking a TensorFlow Keras sequential machine learning model and turning it into a black box input output model as a service with the deep learning neural net model able to predict at 81% accuracy
Created APIs for the machine learning model to make predictions using Python Flask
Launched the Machine Learning Model on a Docker Image hosted on the AWS cloud in an ECS instance
Became a Cyber Secure Software Engineer Associate by doing training and passing an exam on cyber security programing
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon EC2 · Python (Programming Language) · Flask · Machine Learning · Docker · API Development

positions.title: Technology Development Program Intern
positions.description: Experienced project management strategies with the software development life cycle from planning to final deployment and created sprints for the developers in ways that match the goal of the user stories. Assessed new technologies and engineered new ways to apply them to our business case. Collaborated on architecture design and structure for a good codebase for our project. Developed code in Java, SQL, and React JS to modernize an enterprise level legacy system bringing a new one to production, by updating the current Electronic Eligibility Management Systems (EEMS) Online website into a new architecture using micro-services.  Deployed code to the OpenShift Cloud using a Jenkins pipeline and Docker Images. Presented projects to executive members of Optum for feedback and direction to further our project.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Framework · OpenShift · Jenkins · API Development

positions.title: At-Large Representative.
positions.description: Elected with two thousand votes to represent all Penn State undergraduate students in the university’s student government. Allocated funds to provide students with the resources to print resumes on high grade paper through a third-party provider. Collaborated with The VP of IT and other professional staff to improve old and implement new technical services around campus. Collaborated with administrators to provide trays for use in the all you can eat section of East Dining Commons.

positions.title: LEAP Mentor
positions.description: Transitioned a group of twenty-four high school students to college life over the course of the summer. Organized study sessions, community building events, and orientation events such as library and campus tours. Tutored students in English and public speaking courses

positions.title: Student Intern for Portfolio Manager
positions.description: Assisted EPA’s ENERGY STAR National Manager with various projects relating to cost-effectively improving the energy efficiency of commercial buildings with ENERGY STAR tools and resources. Participated in meetings and provided computer technical assistant to organizations using ENERGY STAR Portfolio Manager to track energy consumption - Catholic Archdiocese of Washington, Department of Housing and Urban Development, General Services Administration, White House Council on Environmental Quality, Federal Bureau of Prisons. Participated in software code development sprint for a set of Portfolio Manager enhancements. Gained real world experience regarding how current web-based software tools, such as Portfolio Manager, are used to make businesses more efficient and productive
